official_definition: (Flash) Twinkle Dragonpulse (When Attacks) By summoning one of this Spirit's "Siegfried"-named pre-advent cards without paying the cost, send an opposing Life to the Reserve,

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Twinkle Dragonpulse] or [Twinkle Dragonpulse: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Twinkle Dragonpulse]", "give [Twinkle Dragonpulse]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
